# Personal-PRODUCTION extras manifest: one pin per line, same format as
# extras.txt (staging's manifest — the two are deliberately separate files
# so a staging pin never reaches production by accident).
#
# Every open btli PR, drafts included, is composed automatically; a pin here
# is only for refs outside that stream (a closed PR still carried, or a
# bot-authored PR). Bot-authored pins are never covered by the open-PR stream;
# remove them once merged upstream, or replace them when superseded.
